claims: Deep West tree positions/heights/crowns from 2017 USGS LiDAR canopy peaks (2017 trees, not a tree survey); Union on 24th = City of Austin 2023 footprint + OSM community-sourced overall height 97.5 m (City 2023 89.8 m kept as an older bound); Villas on 24th = OpenStreetMap outline (ODbL) + published 30 storeys / 312 ft; tower facades, podium/tower split and crown layout are photo-interpreted estimates.

towers.name: Union on 24th
towers.footprint: City of Austin Building Footprints 2023 OBJECTID 470235 (single ring; the podium covers it, the H-shaped residential floors sit inside it)
towers.height: COMMUNITY-SOURCED ESTIMATE: OSM way 1208654798 height 97.536 m (320 ft, 29 levels) above the City BASE_ELEVATION 588.94 ft (y 14.51), crown and roof plant counted inside it; the City 2023 MAX_HEIGHT 89.79 m is an older measured snapshot (possibly mid-construction) kept as cityHeightM / cityTopY
towers.identity: OSM way 1208654798 name/address over the City ring; Perkins&Will (29 storeys); Datum Engineers (H-shaped residential floors, 4 above-grade parking levels, level-6 amenity, level-29 pool)

towers.name: Villas on 24th
towers.footprint: OpenStreetMap way 1341073412 (ODbL; tagged building=construction), trimmed against remaining campus.json rings
towers.height: 312 ft (Austin American-Statesman 2023-09-15) = 95.10 m overall incl. the glass amenity crown; 30 storeys (DCI Engineers)
towers.identity: owner villas-sh.com (delivered 2025, 2313 Rio Grande); DCI Engineers / Rhode Partners; replaces demolished City record 614399
